question: What internship programs does WeIntern offer?
answer: WeIntern offers two internship programs: 1) 6-Month Internship Program (₹6,599) — includes 2 months of industry-oriented training + live project experience + internship certificate + all program certificates + mock interview prep + LinkedIn profile building + 100% placement guarantee + performance-based stipend up to ₹10,000. EMI available in 30:40:30 ratio or 10% discount on one-time payment. 2) 3-Month Internship Program (₹999) — includes industry training + internship certificate + applicable certificates + stipend up to ₹10,000 (subject to project availability) + placement support (100% guarantee not included).

question: What is the internship process?
answer: The WeIntern internship process: 1) Register on we-intern.in and choose your program (6-Month ₹6,599 or 3-Month ₹999). 2) Pay via Razorpay (UPI/cards/net banking). 3) Attend online orientation via Google Meet. 4) Complete 2 months of industry-oriented training (6-Month) or industry training (3-Month). 5) Work on live project experience. 6) Receive certificate and placement support.

question: What does the 6-month internship include?
answer:
The 6-Month Internship Program details and price:

• Duration: 6 months
• Price: ₹6,599 (EMI available in 30:40:30 ratio or 10% discount on one-time full payment)
• 2 months of industry-oriented training
• Live project experience
• Internship Completion Certificate
• Training Certificate
• Letter of Recommendation (LOR)
• Mock interview preparation
• LinkedIn profile building
• 100% Placement guarantee & job assistance
• Performance-based stipend up to ₹10,000

question: What does the 3-month internship include?
answer: The 3-Month Internship Program (₹999) includes: ✅ Industry training ✅ Internship certificate + applicable program certificates ✅ Performance-based stipend up to ₹10,000 (subject to project availability and performance) ✅ Placement support (100% placement guarantee is not included, but support is provided). Fee: ₹999 one-time.

question: Is stipend available?
answer: Yes. Both programs offer a performance-based stipend of up to ₹10,000 during the internship/live project phase. For the 3-Month Program, stipend is subject to project availability and performance. For the 6-Month Program, stipend is part of the live project experience phase.

question: What is the stipend amount?
answer: WeIntern offers a performance-based stipend of up to ₹10,000 during the internship/live project phase. This applies to both the 6-Month Program (₹6,599) and the 3-Month Program (₹999, subject to project availability and performance).

question: How can I explain what is the internship process?
answer: The WeIntern internship combines industry-oriented training, live project experience, placement support, certificates, and a stipend. The 6-Month Program (₹6,599) is comprehensive with 100% placement guarantee. The 3-Month Program (₹999) is a shorter, affordable option with placement support.
